scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation and computational spot checks were conducted. Numerical checks are not exhaustive or independent validation. The same-model scientific review is documented separately and independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed nondegenerate finite-sided convex all-ideal hyperbolic three-polyhedra in curvature -1 are covered; the O(s^2) constant need not be uniform as dihedral angles degenerate; no full distance distribution is determined. Full historical priority is not independently certified. The older Euclidean inner-tube comparison was examined in accessible full extracted text.
title: The logarithmic inner-tube coefficient of ideal hyperbolic three-polyhedra
